question: Who inspired Indians by raising the slogan 'Freedom is my birthright and I shall have it!'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Gangadhar Tilak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** was a prominent Indian nationalist, teacher, and an independence activist.
 
• He was one of the first leaders of the Indian Independence Movement and is known for his strong advocacy for Swaraj (self-rule).
